title: Hit counter
statementMd:
Count hits in the last 300 seconds. `['hit', t]` records a hit at time `t`; `['count', t]` returns the number of hits with `t - 300 < time <= t`. Times are non-decreasing. Return the results of `count` operations.

**Example:** `hit_counter([["hit", 1], ["hit", 2], ["hit", 3], ["count", 4], ["hit", …)` returns `[3, 4, 3]`.
hints: Keep a deque of timestamps and drop old ones.
